composition_gate.modern_replay_semantics: PAISA modern-language replay limits language drift; instruction-following preservation is measured by separate fixed evaluation gates, not claimed as instruction-training data.

sampling_policy.broader: sample without exceeding the recorded work and author token-share ceilings; redistribute excess proportionally across uncapped eligible groups
sampling_policy.sonnets: sample V7-train identities only; harmonize epoch labels, cap author and epoch token exposure, and redistribute excess proportionally across uncapped eligible groups
sampling_policy.validation_test: count for audit only and never expose to a training sampler

stage_mixtures.purpose: historical general adaptation with bounded Ottocento exposure and modern-language preservation replay
historical non-sonnet poetry adaptation with stage-1 historical and modern-language replay
low-rate V7 sonnet specialization with stage-2 and modern-language replay
